description:
Calling a function read back from a map or struct field works on develop; what is missing is the fixture that proves it and keeps it.

Probed on develop 135b67da3 (and already on a18fb1519, 9e3a93c4e, 13d4783d0): each shape prints 1001 on interp, run and build, as Elixir does.

    def sample(n), do: %{step: fn x -> x + n end}

    def main() do
      s = sample(1)
      dbg(s.step.(1000))
    end

The same holds for a struct field (`defstruct [:step]`, `%Sample{step: fn x -> x + n end}`), called as `s.step.(1000)` or through `f = s.step; f.(1000)`. The transport.rs panic ("closure callee layout ... carries neither the captures ... nor one public word") no longer reproduces. No fixture calls a closure read from a field: fixture 00855 still carries its function inside a tuple (`{first, tag, step} = s.pair`).

Done when: an oracle fixture covers the three shapes (map field, struct field called directly, struct field through a local) on interp, run and build; fixture 00855 calls its function from the struct field directly instead of from inside a tuple; no pin moves.
title: Calling a closure read from a map or struct field panics the compiler
type: A closure read from a map or struct field is called, and a fixture keeps it so
